scope.population: all raw Kilosort clusters; KS-good counts are descriptive secondary yield

state_assignment.reference: full-session median frozen independently for each field
state_assignment.temporal_cells: half-open cells bounded by adjacent field-time midpoints, clipped to the recording
state_assignment.continuity_interpretation: arm-local state/rate rank continuity proxy only; not biological identity or purity

yield.uncertainty: 300-second common time-block bootstrap for rates and active-unit yield; deterministic full-session counts retained

short_interval.denominator: positive adjacent within-unit intervals wholly inside one contiguous rounded-state segment

exact_duplicates.definition: adjacent spikes in the same cluster at the same sample

chance_aware_coincidence.null: one deterministic circular time shift per cluster on the full recording

presence.definition: fraction of full-session half-open bins containing at least one spike

edge.definition: fraction of processing-domain units outside the scoring domain

state_rate_rank.statistic: Spearman rho across eligible units between log rate at q=0 and log rate at each rounded state
state_rate_rank.report: each state separately with exposure and eligible-unit count

correspondence.exclusive_event_matching: greedy chronological one-to-one within each candidate unit pair

uncertainty.unit_resampling: common unit resampling for paired summaries; arm-local unit resampling otherwise
uncertainty.undefined: report unavailable with denominator and cause; never replace with zero

decision.style: profile-based Pareto reading; no composite score and no tuning
decision.tier2: run only for arms favourable overall on Tier 1

interpretations.production_candidate: A is at least as good as REF on contamination, completeness, and yield, improves continuity/correspondence, and is better than B
interpretations.rounding_not_field: A and B are similar and both beat XR
interpretations.correction_harmful: A and B are worse than REF on contamination, completeness, or yield
